diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says COM, datasheet reading says C
diffs.evidence: Same terminal, different label only. The Omron SS datasheet (original the KW11-3Z copies) labels the SPDT terminals 'COM  NO  NC' in its Contact Form diagram; KW11 seller listings mark the common terminal 'C' on the case. C = COM (common). The model's COM pin description already says 'Common terminal (C)', and pin order COM, NO, NC matches the second reading's C, NO, NC.
